newsitem.title: USA: Tellabs wins contract for Poland network.
newsitem.headline: Tellabs wins contract for Poland network.

text.p: Tellabs Inc said Wednesday it won a contract valued at more than $5 million to provide its Martis DXX managed access and transport network product to Centertel for its mobile telephone network in Poland.
The contract was awarded as part of a countrywide network expansion program and included delivery, installation and commissioning of the product, completed in January, and training.

Centertel is a joint venture between the Polish national operator, TP SA, and France Telecom. The Centertel network currently serves about 151,000 subscribers in Poland, and the expansion will help it offer service throughout the country, covering the entire population of 38 million, Tellabs said.
Tellabs provides voice and data transport and network access systems to communications services providers.
